propositions: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE environment variable must point to a TOML file that layers its keys over discovered config files rather than replacing them entirely
Configuration precedence order must be: CLI -c flags > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env vars > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config file > defaults
Nested table merging must be deep/recursive so that a pointed file overriding one table key preserves sibling keys from the discovered config
Array values in the pointed file must replace (not append to) arrays in the discovered config, allowing environments to pin fallback chains or clear defaults
The environment variable name must be read as a string literal in os.environ.get() calls to ensure static AST scanning for documentation generation
A pointer to a nonexistent file must fail loudly with a typed rebar config error rather than silently falling back to discovered config
